mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_notifications (alert_record_id, channel, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error) VALUES (#{entity.alertRecordId}, #{entity.channel}, #{entity.status}, #{entity.attempts}, #{entity.nextAttemptAt}, #{entity.lastError})
mapper.select: SELECT id, alert_record_id, channel, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_notifications WHERE status = 'pending' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at IS NULL DESC, next_attempt_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, alert_record_id, channel, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at FROM alert_notifications WHERE alert_record_id = #{recordId} ORDER BY id ASC
